rh.statement: Every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part ½.
rh.role: At modulus one the Dirichlet L-function is ζ. The functional equation reflects a zero left of the critical line into the zero-free right half-plane.

grh.statement: For every Dirichlet character, every zero of its L-function in 0 < Re(s) < 1 has real part ½.
grh.role: Passing to a primitive character preserves zeros in the open strip. The functional equation then reflects a zero across the critical line.
